## Common WHERE Filters

- `grass_date = date('YYYY-MM-DD')` -- 单日分区过滤
- `grass_date BETWEEN date('YYYY-MM-DD') AND date('YYYY-MM-DD')` -- 日期范围查询
- `grass_region IN ('ID','PH','SG','TH','TW','MY','VN','BR')` -- 全地区查询
- `grass_region IN ('SG')` -- 单地区过滤
- `type = 'ads'` -- 广告级别分析
- `type = 'item'` -- 商品级别 pCOC 分析
- `type = 'campaign'` -- 计划级别 pCOC/达标率分析
- `type = 'shop'` -- 店铺级别分析
- `pricing_type IN ('11', '24', '25', '27', '15')` -- ROI 类广告（pCOC 分析）
- `pricing_type IN (11, 15)` -- ROI bidding 类型（cold start 分析）
- `pricing_type != 0` -- 排除无效 pricing_type（写入 ads 时）
- `entrance IN ('SEARCH', 'DD', 'YMAL', 'PP')` -- 四大入口过滤（缩写格式）
- `entrance IN ('Daily Discover', 'You May Also Like', 'Search', 'Post Purchase')` -- 入口过滤（全称格式）
- `ads_clk > 0` -- 有点击的广告
- `item_id > 0` -- 有效商品过滤
- `ads_id > 0` -- 有效广告过滤

## Common Aggregations

```sql
-- pCOC & Cost Ratio（campaign 维度）
SUM(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(broad_gmv_usd) AS pcoc
SUM(daily_pay_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(paid_broad_gmv_usd) AS pay_pgmv_pcoc
SUM(daily_model_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(broad_gmv_usd) AS model_pgmv_pcoc
SUM(advv_usd) / SUM(revenue_usd) AS cost_ratio

-- pCOC 达标率（收入加权，0.8-1.2 为达标区间）
SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
  / SUM(revenue_usd) AS valid_pcoc_cost

-- pCOC 达标率（campaign 数加权）
SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  / COUNT(1) AS valid_pcoc_camp

-- 空成本占比（0 订单广告收入占比）
SUM(CASE WHEN broad_order <= 0 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
  / SUM(revenue_usd) AS empty_cost

-- 超收检测（Diagnosis A1: 7d overspend）
SUM(revenue_usd_7d) AS cost_7d,
SUM(advv_usd_7d) AS advv_7d,
SUM(revenue_usd_7d) - SUM(advv_usd_7d) AS over_amount_7d,
SUM(revenue_usd_7d) / NULLIF(SUM(advv_usd_7d), 0) AS cost_ratio_7d
-- WHERE cost_ratio_7d > 1.25 AND over_amount_7d > 0

-- 广告漏斗通过率
after_prerank_num / after_recall_num AS recall_to_prerank_rate
after_rank_num / after_prerank_num AS prerank_to_rank_rate
after_mixrank_num / after_rank_num AS rank_to_mixrank_rate
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: pCOC 达标率 -- campaign 维度（workflow）

```sql
-- Source: workflows/ads_algo/model/pcoc_data/pcoc_daily/reachpcoc_productads_data_1d_rankcr
WITH item_level_data_base AS (
    SELECT
        a.grass_region, grass_date, a.campaign_id,
        SUM(a.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd,
        SUM(a.ads_broad_order) AS broad_order,
        SUM(a.daily_model_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) AS daily_model_pgmv,
        SUM(a.daily_pay_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) AS daily_pay_pgmv,
        SUM(a.daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) AS daily_final_pgmv,
        SUM(a.broad_gmv_usd) AS daily_gmv,
        SUM(a.paid_broad_gmv_usd) AS daily_paid_gmv,
        SUM(a.daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(a.broad_gmv_usd) AS camp_pcoc,
        SUM(a.advv_usd) / SUM(a.revenue_usd) AS camp_costratio
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_union_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live a
    WHERE grass_date = date('${bizTimeFormatter(BIZ_TIME, ''yyyy-MM-dd'', ''-1d'')}')
        AND a.grass_region IN ('ID','PH','TH','MY','VN','SG','TW','BR')
        AND a.pricing_type IN ('11', '24', '25', '27', '15')
        AND a.ads_clk > 0 AND a.item_id > 0 AND a.type = 'campaign'
        AND a.entrance IN ('SEARCH', 'DD', 'YMAL', 'PP')
    GROUP BY a.grass_region, grass_date, a.campaign_id
)
SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt, SUM(revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(daily_final_pgmv) / SUM(daily_gmv) AS final_pgmv_pcoc,
    SUM(daily_pay_pgmv) / SUM(daily_paid_gmv) AS pay_pgmv_pcoc,
    SUM(daily_model_pgmv) / SUM(daily_gmv) AS model_pgmv_pcoc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(revenue_usd) AS valid_pcoc_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(1) AS valid_pcoc_camp,
    SUM(CASE WHEN broad_order <= 0 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(revenue_usd) AS empty_cost,
    grass_region, grass_date
FROM item_level_data_base
GROUP BY grass_region, grass_date
```

### Snippet 2: Item 级 pCOC 分析 -- 手动 ad-hoc 查询

```sql
-- Source: manual_tasks/ramalingam.saravanamani/brand_max/check_antou_issue
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT grass_date, grass_region, item_id,
        daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk / broad_gmv_usd AS pcoc,
        revenue_usd, ads_broad_order
    FROM mkplpaidads_search_ads.ads_union_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region IN ('PH','MY','TH','TW','SG','VN','ID')
        AND type = 'ads'
        AND entrance IN ('Daily Discover','You May Also Like','Search','Post Purchase')
        AND grass_date >= DATE('2026-03-01') AND grass_date <= DATE('2026-03-28')
        AND pricing_type IN (11, 15, 24, 25, 27)
)
SELECT grass_date, grass_region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT item_id) AS item_id_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pcoc >= 0.8 AND pcoc <= 1.2 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
      / SUM(revenue_usd) AS valid_pcoc_rev_ratio
FROM filtered
GROUP BY grass_date, grass_region
```

### Snippet 3: 超收检测 -- Diagnosis A1 anomaly（Python embedded SQL）

```sql
-- Source: services/ads_diagnosis/services/batch_diagnosis_to_excel.py
-- Detection: 7d overspend (cost_ratio_7d > 1.25)
SELECT campaign_id, grass_region,
    SUM(revenue_usd_7d) AS cost_7d,
    SUM(advv_usd_7d) AS advv_7d,
    SUM(broad_gmv_usd_7d) AS gmv_7d,
    SUM(revenue_usd_7d) - SUM(advv_usd_7d) AS over_amount_7d,
    SUM(revenue_usd_7d) / NULLIF(SUM(advv_usd_7d), 0) AS cost_ratio_7d,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY grass_region ORDER BY
        SUM(revenue_usd_7d) - SUM(advv_usd_7d) DESC) AS region_rank
FROM ads_union_key_metrics_daily__reg_s0_live
WHERE type = 'campaign'
    AND grass_date = 'YYYY-MM-DD'
GROUP BY campaign_id, grass_region
HAVING SUM(advv_usd_7d) > 0
    AND SUM(revenue_usd_7d) / SUM(advv_usd_7d) > 1.25
    AND SUM(revenue_usd_7d) - SUM(advv_usd_7d) > 0
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

```sql
-- pCOC（预估 GMV / 实际 GMV，衡量出价预估准确度）
pcoc = SUM(daily_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(broad_gmv_usd)

-- Pay pGMV pCOC（基于实际付款 GMV）
pay_pgmv_pcoc = SUM(daily_pay_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(paid_broad_gmv_usd)

-- Model pGMV pCOC（基于模型预估 GMV）
model_pgmv_pcoc = SUM(daily_model_pgmv_sum_last_7d_clk) / SUM(broad_gmv_usd)

-- Cost Ratio（广告花费 / 收入，反映成本效率）
cost_ratio = SUM(advv_usd) / SUM(revenue_usd)

-- pCOC 达标率（收入加权，达标区间 0.8-1.2）
valid_pcoc_cost = SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
                / SUM(revenue_usd)

-- pCOC 达标率（campaign 数加权）
valid_pcoc_camp = SUM(CASE WHEN camp_pcoc BETWEEN 0.8 AND 1.2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                / COUNT(1)

-- 空成本占比（0 订单广告收入占比）
empty_cost = SUM(CASE WHEN broad_order <= 0 THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
           / SUM(revenue_usd)

-- 7d 超收金额（Diagnosis A1）
over_amount_7d = SUM(revenue_usd_7d) - SUM(advv_usd_7d)
-- WHERE SUM(advv_usd_7d) > 0 AND SUM(revenue_usd_7d)/SUM(advv_usd_7d) > 1.25

-- 注意事项:
-- 1. pricing_type 在表内为 string 类型，WHERE 需用 '11' 而非 11
-- 2. type 列区分实体级别，跨 type 聚合会产生同一个 campaign/item 的重复计数
-- 3. entrance 存在两种格式：缩写 ('SEARCH','DD','YMAL','PP') 和全称 ('Daily Discover','You May Also Like','Search','Post Purchase')
-- 4. deprecated 列: daily_advv_sum_last_7d_clk, daily_pgmv_direct_sum_last_7d_clk, daily_pgmv_broad_sum_last_7d_clk (标记为 "废弃")
-- 5. 两个 schema 版本并存：旧版 117 列 vs 新版 164 列（with omni），字段名前缀相同的列在新旧版本中含义一致
```
